unit_outcome.en: Handle essential personal information across a first spoken and written contact.
unit_outcome.ar: تواصل لأول مرة وتبادل المعلومات الشخصية الأساسية شفهيًا وكتابيًا.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh short social exchange, the learner can greet someone, ask how they are, react to simple news, and say goodbye.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh clear introduction, the learner can identify the speaker's main personal information without a transcript.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh first-meeting situation, the learner can give a short self-introduction with essential personal details without a complete model.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh short exchange, the learner can ask and answer direct personal-detail questions without a dialogue model.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh short phone context, identify a name and phone number without a transcript; confirm by selection or oral check.
lessons.mastery_action: Score the heard identity details; do not require written recording for mastery.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh short text, the learner can locate requested personal details without answer-revealing support.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

lessons.outcome_statement: Complete a fresh very simple paper or digital personal application form under clear labels without copying a completed model.
lessons.mastery_action: Use fictional details and changed field order; score required entries, not interface navigation speed.

lessons.outcome_statement: Write two or three short factual sentences about self or one familiar or fictional person without copying.
lessons.mastery_action: Use a changed person and required facts; an absent or misattributed fact is critical.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh short written exchange, the learner can ask for or pass on basic personal details without copying a model.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

unit_review.fresh_variant_policy: Change people, details, order, visuals, roles, or context; never reuse an answer-bearing model.

mastery_stations.title: A first meeting
mastery_stations.fresh_task: Meet a new fictional partner, understand their introduction, introduce yourself, and exchange two changed details.
mastery_stations.critical_failure: A person or required detail is misunderstood, absent, or attributed to the wrong speaker.

mastery_stations.title: Contact and form details
mastery_stations.fresh_task: Use a fresh voice message and profile card to complete a blank form with fictional contact details.
mastery_stations.critical_failure: A required identity or contact detail is missing or changed.

mastery_stations.title: Profile and reply
mastery_stations.fresh_task: Write a new short profile and answer one changed personal-detail question without a complete model.
mastery_stations.critical_failure: A required fact is missing, copied as an answer, or assigned to the wrong person.

unit_outcome.en: Understand and exchange simple information about people, routines, preferences, and plans.
unit_outcome.ar: افهم وتبادل معلومات بسيطة عن الناس والروتين والتفضيلات والمواعيد.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh slow conversation, the learner can identify basic facts about a person or family.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh predictable conversation, the learner can ask and answer basic questions about family or friends.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

lessons.outcome_statement: Describe and introduce one familiar or fictional person in two or three short sentences; use learner-prepared notes only for a formal variant.
lessons.mastery_action: Use a changed person and audience; score identity and required descriptive facts.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh slow conversation, the learner can identify people's leisure preferences and abilities.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh short text, the learner can identify familiar everyday activities and their basic sequence.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

lessons.outcome_statement: Describe three familiar everyday activities in a clear simple sequence, with time or frequency where useful.
lessons.mastery_action: Score a fresh spoken routine; short writing is delayed transfer.

lessons.outcome_statement: Exchange basic routine, leisure, ability, and preference information in a short two-way conversation.
lessons.mastery_action: Mastery stays oral interaction; a one-sentence post is delayed transfer, not a second construct.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh short message, the learner can identify what to do, when, and where to meet.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh simple scheduling exchange, understand and give an event date and time and record the agreed details accurately.
lessons.mastery_action: Use changed dates and roles; score the agreed date/time across listening and response.

unit_review.fresh_variant_policy: Change people, details, order, visuals, roles, or context; never reuse an answer-bearing model.

mastery_stations.title: People and family
mastery_stations.fresh_task: Hear changed family details, ask one question, then describe and introduce one fictional person.
mastery_stations.critical_failure: The relationship, identity, or required descriptive fact is reversed or absent.

mastery_stations.title: Routine and preferences
mastery_stations.fresh_task: Use fresh input to compare two routines, describe yours, and exchange one preference and ability.
mastery_stations.critical_failure: The sequence, preference, ability, or required routine fact changes meaning.

mastery_stations.title: Make a plan
mastery_stations.fresh_task: Read a changed invitation, agree a new date and time, and record the final arrangement.
mastery_stations.critical_failure: The action, date, time, or place is missing or wrong.

unit_outcome.en: Identify, describe, and locate familiar things and follow short spoken and written instructions.
unit_outcome.ar: حدّد ووصف مكان الأشياء المألوفة ونفّذ تعليمات قصيرة مسموعة ومكتوبة.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh familiar activity, act on two or three basic spoken instructions in order.
lessons.mastery_action: Score required actions; speaking is optional repair, not part of mastery.

lessons.outcome_statement: Describe a familiar visible object orally using two or three identifying details so another person can select it.
lessons.mastery_action: Use an unseen object set; short writing is delayed transfer.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh visual information gap, the learner can exchange basic colour, size, and quantity facts about objects.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

lessons.outcome_statement: Exchange a few home or possession facts and locate two people or objects in a fresh home information gap.
lessons.mastery_action: Use changed rooms and object positions; score the requested facts and locations.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh pictured-room task, the learner can write a very simple description of the room and object positions.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh familiar task, the learner can follow two or three short written instructions in order.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

lessons.outcome_statement: From a fresh short illustrated story, the learner can identify the main situation and basic event sequence.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

unit_review.fresh_variant_policy: Change people, details, order, visuals, roles, or context; never reuse an answer-bearing model.

mastery_stations.title: Act on instructions
mastery_stations.fresh_task: Complete a new familiar task using changed spoken commands and short written steps.
mastery_stations.critical_failure: A required action is omitted, reversed, or performed in the wrong order.

mastery_stations.title: Object and home gap
mastery_stations.fresh_task: Identify a hidden object, exchange changed room locations, and write a short description of the final room.
mastery_stations.critical_failure: The intended object or a required location cannot be identified.

mastery_stations.title: Illustrated story
mastery_stations.fresh_task: Use new illustrations to identify the main situation and order three events.
mastery_stations.critical_failure: The main situation or basic event order is misunderstood.

unit_outcome.en: Find place information, follow or clarify routes, and complete basic travel and hotel exchanges.
unit_outcome.ar: افهم معلومات الأماكن والاتجاهات وتعامل في مواقف السفر والفندق الأساسية.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh simple plan, the learner can follow short written directions to a destination.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh simple plan, the learner can follow slow spoken route directions.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

lessons.outcome_statement: Ask for, follow, and clarify basic live directions to one destination on a simple map.
lessons.mastery_action: Use changed roles and destination; score successful route understanding and necessary repair.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh predictable guided-tour setting, identify the place or topic and one main fact from a very simple explanation.
lessons.mastery_action: Use a changed place and speaker; score the topic and required fact.

title.ar: اقرأ معلومات عن مكان أو فندق

lessons.outcome_statement: In fresh simple place information, the learner can identify two essential facts.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

lessons.outcome_statement: Identify a required destination or time detail in very slow travel information and buy the intended basic ticket with one detail.
lessons.mastery_action: Use changed destinations and ticket options; score the ticket obtained and essential detail.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh simple hotel situation, the learner can check in using basic fixed expressions.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

unit_review.fresh_variant_policy: Change people, details, order, visuals, roles, or context; never reuse an answer-bearing model.

mastery_stations.title: Find the route
mastery_stations.fresh_task: Use a new map to follow written and spoken routes, ask for one clarification, and reach the destination.
mastery_stations.critical_failure: The route ends at the wrong destination or an essential clarification is not made.

mastery_stations.title: Understand a place
mastery_stations.fresh_task: Use fresh tour audio and place information to identify the place and two required practical facts.
mastery_stations.critical_failure: The place, topic, or a required practical fact is wrong.

mastery_stations.title: Travel and stay
mastery_stations.fresh_task: Use changed travel information to buy the intended ticket, then check in with new fictional booking details.
mastery_stations.critical_failure: The wrong ticket is obtained or an essential booking detail is changed.

unit_outcome.en: Use simple information to buy, order, request help, and explain an immediate health need.
unit_outcome.ar: استخدم معلومات بسيطة للشراء والطلب وطلب المساعدة وشرح احتياج صحي فوري.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh simple advertisement or leaflet, the learner can find two important practical details.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

lessons.outcome_statement: Choose an item and quantity, understand or state the cost, and complete the essential selection in a simple shop or digital purchase.
lessons.mastery_action: Use changed items and prices; score the intended item, quantity, and cost.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh simple service exchange, ask for one food or drink item and state or answer one basic preference.
lessons.mastery_action: Use changed menu options; score the intended order and preference meaning.

title.en: Ask for an Item or Help

lessons.outcome_statement: Ask for or give a common item or practical help and exchange one essential detail about an immediate need.
lessons.mastery_action: Use a changed need and role; score whether the intended help or item is understood.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh basic health exchange, the learner can state a simple problem and answer one question.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

unit_review.fresh_variant_policy: Change people, details, order, visuals, roles, or context; never reuse an answer-bearing model.

mastery_stations.title: Choose and buy
mastery_stations.fresh_task: Use a fresh advert to choose an item and complete a purchase with changed quantity and price.
mastery_stations.critical_failure: The intended item, quantity, or total cost is wrong.

mastery_stations.title: Order and ask for help
mastery_stations.fresh_task: In new service scenes, place one order and ask for an item or practical help with one detail.
mastery_stations.critical_failure: The intended order, item, or requested help is not understood.

mastery_stations.title: Health need
mastery_stations.fresh_task: Explain a changed simple symptom and answer one predictable follow-up question.
mastery_stations.critical_failure: The symptom or safety-relevant answer changes meaning.

unit_outcome.en: Understand and create short messages, relay practical information, and participate in simple shared responses.
unit_outcome.ar: افهم وأنشئ رسائل قصيرة وانقل معلومات عملية وشارك في تواصل جماعي بسيط.

title.ar: اترك رسالة عن مكانك وموعد رجوعك

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh simple note, the learner can say where they have gone and when they will return.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

title.en: Read and Reply to a Friend

lessons.outcome_statement: Read a fresh very short personal message or postcard and write a short reply containing one required fact or question.
lessons.mastery_action: Use changed content; score the required response, not imitation of the source wording.

lessons.outcome_statement: Understand a fresh simple English sign or notice and relay one practical meaning or required action accurately in Arabic.
lessons.mastery_action: Score practical meaning and action; dictionary use is guided practice, not answer-revealing mastery support.

title.en: Identify a Topic or Product in Video
title.ar: حدّد موضوع أو منتج في فيديو

lessons.outcome_statement: Identify a familiar topic or product and one explicit detail in a fresh short visual-supported news or advertisement clip.
lessons.mastery_action: Use a changed clip; score the topic or product and required detail.

lessons.outcome_statement: In a fresh simple online exchange, the learner can post a short reaction and answer one follow-up with thanks or apology.
lessons.mastery_action: Retain the current fresh mastery construct.

title.en: Say How a Work Made You Feel
title.ar: قل كيف جعلك عمل بسيط تشعر

lessons.outcome_statement: After a fresh simple safe creative work, state orally in one or two simple phrases how it made you feel.
lessons.mastery_action: Score a relevant spoken feeling response; writing is delayed transfer.

title.en: Share an Idea and Invite Others

lessons.outcome_statement: During a fresh very simple task, share one prepared idea, invite another person, show interest, and check one point of understanding.
lessons.mastery_action: Use changed roles and task; score the required collaborative moves without supplying their wording.

lessons.outcome_statement: From fresh very slow English input, relay in Arabic one or two predictable names, numbers, times, prices, or place details without changing them.
lessons.mastery_action: Use a declared English-to-Arabic task and score preservation of the essential details.

unit_review.fresh_variant_policy: Change people, details, order, visuals, roles, or context; never reuse an answer-bearing model.

mastery_stations.title: Messages and online response
mastery_stations.fresh_task: Use changed prompts to leave a whereabouts message, reply to a friend, and react politely online.
mastery_stations.critical_failure: A required destination, return time, fact, question, or social response is missing.

mastery_stations.title: Public and visual information
mastery_stations.fresh_task: Identify a fresh sign meaning and a video topic or product, then relay one practical sign detail in Arabic.
mastery_stations.critical_failure: The required action, topic, product, or relayed practical meaning is wrong.

mastery_stations.title: Respond and collaborate
mastery_stations.fresh_task: Respond to a new safe creative work, share one idea, invite input, and check one point of understanding.
mastery_stations.critical_failure: The feeling is unrelated or a required collaborative move is absent.

mastery_stations.title: Relay exact details
mastery_stations.fresh_task: Hear a new very slow English message and relay two requested predictable details in Arabic.
mastery_stations.critical_failure: A relayed name, number, time, price, or place detail is omitted or changed.

exact_item_placements.label: Present be: questions and short answers
Present simple: questions and short answers
Would like and want: bounded wants
A/an, the, and bounded zero article
This: near reference and current time
Clock time, dates, and basic time placement
basic size, shape, and age descriptors
simple online form and purchase prompts
Segment names, numbers, and key details
Stress in names, jobs, months, and nationalities
Hear and highlight the key detail
Recognise frequent contractions in clear chunks
Deliver short sense groups with safe pauses
Repeat, slow, or spell a key item to repair

exit_assessment.fresh_variant_policy: Use unseen concrete tasks with changed details; clarify the task but never supply the response.

stations.title: Listening
stations.fresh_task: Extract required details from new slow personal, route, and travel recordings without transcripts.
stations.critical_failure: A required identity, route, or travel detail is wrong.

stations.title: Reading
stations.fresh_task: Find required details and actions in fresh profiles, plans, adverts, and signs.
stations.critical_failure: A requested fact or practical action is wrong.

stations.title: Speaking
stations.fresh_task: Produce short changed personal, people, routine, and object descriptions without a complete model.
stations.critical_failure: The listener cannot identify the person, sequence, or object.

stations.title: Writing
stations.fresh_task: Complete a new form and produce short changed profile, room, and whereabouts writing.
stations.critical_failure: A required fact or location is missing or assigned incorrectly.

stations.title: Oral interaction
stations.fresh_task: Complete new personal, direction, service, help, and health exchanges with permitted repetition and repair.
stations.critical_failure: The intended information, route, order, help, or symptom is not understood.

stations.title: Written online interaction
stations.fresh_task: Complete a fresh short written exchange, reply, reaction, and simple digital purchase selection.
stations.critical_failure: A required response or transaction choice is absent or wrong.

stations.title: Mediation
stations.fresh_task: Relay changed English details or sign meaning in Arabic and support one simple shared task.
stations.critical_failure: Essential meaning changes or a required facilitation move is absent.

exit_assessment.decision_rule: Pass requires every station's essential meaning and task outcome; strengths do not cancel a critical failure in another dimension.

unit1_prototype_migration.migration_rule: Preserve useful authored content, but rebuild manifests, exact targets, practice, and mastery against A1 scope-and-sequence v1.

review.statement: A1 v1 is locked at six units and 45 capabilities; content authoring may proceed without scope drift.
